warrants.quote: The warrants are exercisable at any time and from time to time, in whole or in part, during the four and a half-year period commencing August 12, 2021, at a price of $12.00 per share

the Company issued 1,169,288 warrants to investors to purchase up to a number of shares of Class A Common Stock equal to the number of shares of Class A Common Stock purchased by such investor in the offering, at an exercise price of $17.50 per share.
We also issued Representative Warrants exercisable for 46,772 shares of Class A Common Stock to affiliates of Placement Agent with an initial exercise price of $17.50 per share.
